unit: scale factor (star field, relative to f3976)
sampling: captured pictures only (24/30 fps cadence on the 60 fps grid)
note: whole-frame push-in measured on the P2 star field (4-point stars): per pair of pictures a similarity without rotation (scale about the frame centre + shift) fitted to 6-29 matched stars, composed relative to f3976 (scratch/v5c6_starfield_fit.csv, script scratch/v5c6_tools/starfield_fit.py; f3987 is skipped as a chain link because ring 2 crosses the field). The field had been contracting (x0.88 over f3957-f3972, tail of the whip-tilt) and reverses at f3972-f3976; the push accelerates into the white flash (scale rate 0.40 / 0.71 / 0.57 / 0.81 / 1.22 % per frame over f3976-80 / 80-85 / 85-90 / 90-95 / 95-4000). It never settles: progress 1 is f4000, the last picture with enough stars (they are lost in the flash after f4002). Other matchings give x1.18-1.23 at f4000; single stars grow 18-24 % in radius from the frame centre. Near (large) sparkles stream out 2-3x faster than the small stars (depth parallax): a 3D dolly or fly-through, not a flat zoom; the focus of expansion sits below the frame centre (fits 32-52 % W, 61-75 % H).
